feed.title: Salesforce after Dreamforce: How the CRM giant can grow beyond its own interface
feed.summary: Salesforce's future growth hinges on AI agents doing more work outside its traditional interface, transforming customer interaction from application screens to desired outcomes. The company is developing an enterprise AI harness, combining data, business knowledge, workflows, and controls, to integrate deterministic software with large language models. This approach, supported by customer interest in "Agentforce" and "Headless" access, aims to position Salesforce as the essential system for making AI useful to businesses, extending its reach beyond its own UI and potentially increasing consumption on its platform.

feed.title: KeyCorp Reaffirms 2026 Outlook as Loan Growth, Margins and Fees Gain Momentum
feed.summary: KeyCorp has reaffirmed its 2026 outlook, citing strong client activity, anticipated commercial loan growth at the higher end of its 4-5% target, improved credit quality, and deposit growth exceeding 2% in the latter half of the year. The bank raised its fee-income growth outlook to 4-5% following the Clearwater acquisition and is increasingly confident in achieving a core return on tangible common equity of over 15% by 2027. Despite a changing economic backdrop with expected rate increases, KeyCorp sees continued healthy activity in both lending and fee-based businesses.

feed.title: NASDAQ: ASTS: Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP Announces
feed.summary: Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP has announced the filing of a securities fraud class action lawsuit against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. (NASDAQ: ASTS). feed.title: Costco brings back a fan-favorite food court treat after years off the menu

The announcement followed a cryptic social media tease from the company, sparking widespread speculation among shoppers. While many celebrated the churro's return at its original price of $1.49, some expressed disappointment that it was only for a limited time or that it wasn't the older, classic straight version.

feed.title: Cencora (COR) Raised Guidance and Bought Back $1B. What’s the Catch?
feed.summary: Cencora (COR) reported strong fiscal third-quarter results, with revenue up 5.1% and adjusted EPS climbing 12.0%, leading to raised full-year guidance and $1 billion in stock repurchases. However, this profit growth significantly outpaced sales growth, driven by the OneOncology acquisition which also introduced higher operating expenses and debt. The article highlights a key tension: while profit margins improved due to the acquisition, the long-term sustainability is questioned by increased costs, interest expenses, and the rising volume of lower-margin GLP-1 drugs.

feed.title: Arnold Schwarzenegger helped protect 240,000 acres of California ranchland; the vast habitat is home to rare species and condors
feed.summary: Former California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger played a significant role in the landmark 2008 agreement that protected up to 240,000 acres of the 270,000-acre Tejon Ranch. This vast ranchland, located at the confluence of four ecological regions, is crucial habitat for the California condor and over 60 other at-risk plant and animal species. While Schwarzenegger publicly announced the deal, the negotiations were primarily conducted between the Tejon Ranch Company and five major environmental organizations, establishing a long-term conservation and land-use framework.

feed.title: The Discontinued Campbell's Canned Soup Flavor That Left A Hole In Some Holiday Traditions

For those looking to recreate the flavor, alternatives include using Blue Runner's cream of shrimp soup, doctoring Campbell's cream of onion soup with shrimp and tomato puree, or making a scratch-made version.

feed.title: Amgen or Merck: Which Drugmaker Has the Stronger Dividend Growth Story?
feed.summary: This article compares Amgen (AMGN) and Merck (MRK) as dividend growth investments, concluding that Amgen offers a stronger dividend growth story. Amgen provides a higher current yield, more consistent and aggressive dividend raises, and a more diversified product portfolio, making its dividend more durable against future patent expirations. Merck, while having growth potential, relies heavily on its Keytruda franchise and faces challenges with its pipeline execution.
